meta.notes: Sarcoma taxonomy plus a pan-oncology/haematology layer (layer=pan_oncology). 'names' are matched case-insensitively with word boundaries and optional plural; 'abbreviations' are matched case-sensitively. An abbreviation with safe=false is only accepted when the text defines it next to a long form, e.g. 'osteosarcoma (OS)'. In all-caps titles only safe abbreviations are used. Tags are emitted at the deepest matched node; ancestors are listed in rollup and suppressed as separate tags. OncoTree codes are given only where confident (null otherwise). Bucket nodes (kind=bucket) are also suppressed when another tagged disease belongs to the bucket's group (e.g. 'bone tumor' + GCTB). Track/session-derived diseases are kept only if no title/abstract disease exists or they are ancestors/descendants of one.
